applicableAreas: Entire site, particularly NE portion where drainage and greenbelt easements are located
findings.comment: Two critical recorded easements (Greenbelt Access & Use Easement Instrument 2010070731, 0.31 acres; City of Austin Drainage Easement Instrument 2011021137, 0.130 acres) and four additional GIS-confirmed easements (10' Wastewater, 25' Drainage, 7.5' Public Utility, 10' Drainage) are not depicted on submitted site plan, preventing verification that utility easement boundaries do not encroach into proposed public right-of-way. Applicant must add all recorded easement boundaries to site plan before compliance can be verified.

Submitted site plan does not show a dedicated AE easement encumbering transformer pad locations, nor is there notation of a License Agreement from AE Public Involvement per UCM § 1.10.10.3 or a City Manager license per § 14-11-41 for items within recorded utility easements. Utility easement status and licensing compliance cannot be verified from submitted documents. Provide AE easement plat or evidence of required license agreements.

applicableAreas: Transformer Pad 3 (west of Unit 801); Transformer Pad 2 (between Units 404 and 504)
findings.comment: Transformer Pad 3 is positioned less than 5 feet (nearly flush) against the exterior wall of Unit 801, violating the minimum 10-foot clearance requirement from any adjacent building or structure per UCM § 1.10.4(hot-stick/padlocked side). Transformer Pad 2, located in the tight corridor between Units 404 and 504, also appears to be positioned less than 10 feet from building exteriors. Additionally, no dedicated AE easement is shown on the site plan to encumber the transformer pad areas as required. Relocate transformer pads to satisfy minimum 10-foot clearance from all adjacent structures, and provide a dedicated AE easement plat encumbering the pad locations.
